title.it: Russia Report del comitato intelligence britannico
title.en: Russia Report of the UK Intelligence and Security Committee

description.it: Il rapporto UK critica la mancata valutazione post-Brexit dell’interferenza; non stabilisce che Mosca abbia determinato il referendum.
description.en: The UK report criticises the failure to assess interference after Brexit; it does not establish that Moscow determined the referendum.
